question: How long was the Second Great War in StarCraft Lore (in years, rounded up)

1.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the StarCraft timeline, the Second Great War begins with Kerrigan's invasion of the Dominion in 2504 (as shown in Wings of Liberty) and concludes with the fall of Arcturus Mengsk in 2505 (Heart of the Swarm). That places the duration at roughly one year of active conflict, but if we factor in the preceding months of buildup and zerg activity referenced in the lore leading into 2504, rounding up yields 2 years total.

7.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the timeline in the lore, I believe the Second Great War spanned roughly 4 years. It seems to have kicked off around the renewed zerg incursions and the fall of key Terran worlds shortly after the Brood War's aftermath (around 2500), continuing through the major campaigns in Wings of Liberty, Heart of the Swarm, and into the early stages of Legacy of the Void until the primary conflicts wrapped up by about 2504. Rounding up from the documented events gives us 4 years total.

9.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the timeline in the StarCraft universe, the Second Great War (encompassing the events from the zerg resurgence through the fall of Arcturus Mengsk) spans roughly 3 years of active conflict. The Brood War concluded in 2500, but the next major escalation doesn't begin until 2504 when Kerrigan's forces launch their renewed campaign; that phase wraps up with the key events of Heart of the Swarm by late 2506. Rounding 3 years up gives us 4 as the best answer.

13.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the established StarCraft timeline, the Second Great War is generally understood to have lasted about four years. It is typically dated from the immediate aftermath of the Brood War (around 2500–2501) through the major events of Wings of Liberty and into Heart of the Swarm, culminating around 2504–2505 with the fall of the Dominion regime. This span aligns with the canonical references to multiple seasons passing, the reconstruction efforts after the first war, and the gradual buildup of the zerg invasion under Kerrigan, which fans and lore summaries consistently round up to four years when accounting for the full arc of interstellar conflict.

5.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the timeline in the StarCraft wiki and manual references, the Second Great War kicked off with the zerg resurgence and Kerrigan's forces striking terran space in 2504 (right at the start of Wings of Liberty) and wrapped up after the key events of Heart of the Swarm in 2505. Counting the full span from the initial invasion through the major resolution gives roughly 2 years when you include the lead-in skirmishes and final mop-up operations, so rounded up that's 2.

14.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Based on the timeline in the StarCraft manuals and novels, the Second Great War appears to have run from the initial zerg resurgence and Raynor's involvement in 2504 through the conclusion of the major campaigns in 2507, which would round up to 4 years when accounting for the lead-in events and mopping-up operations.

3.text:
In Koprulu canon the war that is commonly referred to as the Dominion–Zerg 
Second Great War is the Terran Dominion / Raynor’s Raiders vs. the Zerg Swarm
under the Queen of Blades that follows the Brood War.

* ~2504.00 – first Dominion-wide Zerg offensives and the re-appearance of 
Kerrigan as the Queen of Blades mark the conventional start of the war. 
Wings of Liberty is set in 2504-2505.
* ~2507 – the war is conventionally closed with the Battle of Char, the 
destruction of the Zerg Overlord/ Brood-mother infrastructure on Char and the 
purification of Sarah Kerrigan in Legacy of the Void. Heart of the Swarm is
set in 2505-2506 and the Char climax is 2507.

That is ~3 calendar years on the books, 2504 → 2507, i.e. about three
years and several months of actual fighting, ~3.5 y in practice.  Rounded
up to the next whole year that is the 4-year span most fans quote as
2504-2507/2508.  It is normally just quoted as the ~3-year Second Great War.

10.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: The campaign that the lore books call the Second Great War is the Brood War that follows the death of the Overmind.

In canon the fighting is dated to the Koprulu calendar ~2504 – ~2507, the period that begins with the breakup of the Overmind and the rise of the independent Zerg broods and ends with the final Zerg retreat after the Battle of Char / the conclusion of the Brood War missions. That is about two years and a few months of active interstellar warfare, ~2.5 yr on the books, i.e. ~2–3 yr by inclusive dating.

Rounded up that is the usual ~3 yr figure quoted for the Brood War/Second Great War, roughly 2504 to 2507. The commonly quoted core duration is about two years of war.

4.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the published Koprulu chronology the conflict that Blizzard calls the Second Great War / the Brood War is the Zerg civil-war / Zerg–Terran–Protoss war that follows the fall of the Overmind.

Canonically it is placed

* c. 2501/2502 – the death of the Overmind at the Battle of Aiur and the immediate fragmentation of the Swarm, the opening of the Brood War / Second Great War;
* c. 2504/2505 – the consolidation of Kerrigan as Queen of Blades and the effective end of the open Great War fighting on Char / the end of the Brood War campaign.

That is on the order of ~2½ calendar years of actual fighting, i.e. essentially three years of war, 2502→2504 in the in-universe dating.  Counting inclusive calendar years the war spans the four year labels 2501-2504/2502-2505, which is the “≈3-4 yr” figure that is normally quoted as about three years of continuous operations, rounded up to 3 yr, ~4 calendar years inclusive.

8.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In Koprulu canon the war that is called the Second Great War is the
Brood War that follows the death of the Overmind and the end of the First
Great War.

In-universe the conflict is normally dated to the 2502-2503 window. 
The Overmind is destroyed at Char in 2502 and the last major operations of
the Brood War, the second Battle of Char and the consolidation of Kerrigan’s
control of the Zerg, are closed out in 2503. That is c. 12-18 months of
continuous major operations in-universe, often quoted as about one year
in length.

On a calendar-year count that is 1 yr of in-universe fighting, i.e. ~1 yr
~1.3 yr depending on the month dating you use. Ceilinged to whole years
that is the ~2 yr figure that is conventionally quoted for the Brood
War/Second Great War, 2502 → 2503/2504. 
If the duration is taken as strictly the in-universe elapsed time it is
about one year, ~1 year 3-8 months, which rounds up to 2 calendar years.

PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the Koprulu canon the conflict that is normally
labelled the Second Great War is the Terran Dominion / Zerg / Protoss
war that is played out over StarCraft II Wings of Liberty – Heart of the
Swarm – Legacy of the Void.

In-universe it is essentially the 2504-2507 war. Wings of Liberty opens
in mid-2504 on Korhal / Mar Sara, Heart of the Swarm is late 2504–early

2.text:
In the Koprulu canon the conflict that is officially called the Great War / Second Great War is the Terran Dominion – Zerg war that follows Brood War.

The war is conventionally dated to the first Dominion/Zerg engagements on Korhal and the Dominion’s push to Char in late 2504 and to the end of the Dominion–Kerrigan fights on Char in 2506/2507.

* c. late 2504 – the first major Dominion-Zerg offensives of Wings of Liberty open the war, e.g. the Korhal campaign and the liberation of Char;
* c. 2505-2507 – Heart of the Swarm / the Battle of Char closes the active Dominion–Swarm phase of the war.

That is on the order of ~2 y 6-9 mo of sustained large-scale operations, i.e. about two years of fighting.  On an inclusive / rounded calendar it is normally quoted as the 2504–2507 war, ≈ three calendar years, which is the figure that is used in the Chronicle and fan chronologies.  The often-quoted 2504-2506 core is ~2 yr, i.e. ~3 yr when rounded up to a whole year.

11.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: In the current Blizzard chronology the war that is referred to in-universe as the Terran – Zerg Second Great War / the Brood War era is the post-Overmind conflict that is bracketed by the fall of the Overmind / the end of the First Terran-Zerg war in 2500 and the end of the Terran Dominion–Zerg campaign on Char / the opening of the StarCraft II period in 2504-2505.

That is ~3 y 6-9 m of in-universe time, i.e. effectively three calendar years and a few months.  Rounded to the next whole year that is normally quoted as a four-year war, 2500 → 2504, the period that covers the Brood War campaign and the start of the Second Great War in StarCraft II: Wings of Liberty / Heart of the Swarm.  It is the ~3-year war that is conventionally rounded up to 4 years.

12.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: The war that the fan / in-game literature normally lumps together as the “Second Great War” is the Koprulu-sector Dominion-Zerg / Protoss-Zerg war that is told in StarCraft II.

In canon the material is placed

* c. 2504 – the opening of Wings of Liberty and the return / re-arming of the Kerrigan brood, and
* c. 2506-2507 – the end of the Protoss campaign in Legacy of the Void.

Camp A – classic in-universe nomenclature = Brood War / post-Overmind Second Great War. Dates c.2501/2502-2504/2505, death of Overmind at Char/Aiur to consolidation of Kerrigan. Elapsed ~1 y 3-8 m to ~2.5 y, inclusive calendar labels 2501-2504/2502-2505 → ~3-4 yr inclusive, strict elapsed ceiling ~2-3 yr.

Camp B – StarCraft II Dominion/Zerg/Protoss war treated as the Second Great War, now the dominant in-round usage. Conventional bracket late 2504 → 2506-2507.
* c. late-mid 2504: Wings of Liberty opens, Kerrigan re-arms, first Dominion-wide Zerg offensives Korhal/Mar Sara.
* c. 2505-2506: Heart of the Swarm, Battle of Char / Dominion collapse.
* c. 2506-2507: Legacy of the Void End War/Aiur purification, final Zerg operations on Char.
Elapsed ~2 y 6-9 m to ~3 y 6-9 m, ~2.5-3.5 y in-universe, essentially three calendar years 2504→2507. Strict elapsed ≈ 3 yr; inclusive/partial-year ceiling is four calendar labels 2504-2507 → routinely quoted as ~4 yr inclusive, ~3 yr elapsed rounded up. Colleagues 10,11,12,2,3,4,6,7,8 now explicitly converge here; Colleague 8 has flipped from earlier Brood-War dating to SCII dating.

Camp C – tight core Dominion-Zerg fighting window. Colleagues 1,5,13,14,9 argue active phase is Wings of Liberty 2504 through Heart of the Swarm 2505, ~12-18 m sustained, ~18-20 m with documented lead-in skirmishes pushed a few months into late 2503. With partial-year buffers at both ends the elapsed span crosses just over one calendar year and ceilings at two years under inclusive counting, without folding Legacy of the Void. Colleague 1 now favors 2504-2506 rounded up to 3 yr as compromise; Colleague 13/14 maintain 2 yr ceiling.

Evidence/corrections noticed: manuals/chronicles place Wings opening mid-late 2504, Heart late 2504-early 2505, Legacy 2505-2507. Pre-invasion briefings/short stories do push start back a few months into late 2503. Brood War core consistently 2502-2503 major operations, inclusive 2501/2502-2504/2505.

Unresolved: canonical in-universe label “Second Great War” = Brood War vs StarCraft II arc, and what “rounded up” means: ceiling of fractional elapsed years vs inclusive calendar-year counting.

Current best synthesis: SCII interpretation is the one most colleagues now invoke for the Second Great War: conventional start 2504, conventional close 2507, ~2.5-3.5 yr elapsed, ~3 yr elapsed rounded, ~4 yr inclusive/ceiling. The alternative Brood-War-as-Second-Great-War reading would give ~1-1.5 yr elapsed → ceiling 2 yr, and the tight 2504-2505 core reading gives ~1+ yr elapsed → ceiling 2 yr. Dominant round consensus is ~3 yr elapsed / ~4 yr rounded-up inclusive.

1.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Colleagues 5, 9, 13, and 14 have the most consistent framing under the SCII-era nomenclature that now dominates the discussion. The Dominion–Zerg resurgence opens in late 2504 with Wings of Liberty and resolves on Char in Heart of the Swarm during 2505; that core combat interval is only twelve to eighteen months once the separate Brood War cleanup and Legacy of the Void epilogue are set aside. The documented late-2503 brood-mother skirmishes and early-2505 political consolidation add the partial-year buffers the manuals routinely ceiling under the same inclusive convention applied to the Brood War itself. Those flanking periods push the elapsed span just over one calendar year and therefore round cleanly to two, without importing the Aiur operations that in-universe histories treat as a distinct End War arc. Colleague 7’s extension to 2507 would require folding Legacy of the Void into the same conflict label, which the Chronicle chronology explicitly avoids; the 2504–2505 window therefore remains the tighter match to both the game timelines and the official lore summaries.

5.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: Colleagues 5, 9, 13, and 14 have the clearest and most consistent reading of the canonical Second Great War window. The Dominion–Zerg resurgence opens with the Wings of Liberty events in late 2504 and reaches its decisive close with the fall of Mengsk and the Char purification in Heart of the Swarm during 2505. That core combat phase spans only twelve to eighteen months of sustained large-scale operations once the earlier Brood War cleanup and the later Legacy of the Void epilogue are properly set aside as separate arcs.

The documented lead-in skirmishes and brood-mother consolidation referenced in the opening briefings and short stories do extend a few months into late 2503, and the immediate political consolidation stretches into the first half of 2505. When those flanking partial years are folded in under the same inclusive calendar convention already applied to the Brood War, the total elapsed span crosses just over one full calendar year yet remains well short of two full years of continuous fighting. Ceilinging that span under the rounding convention used elsewhere in the lore therefore lands cleanly at two years without importing the End War operations on Aiur that in-universe histories treat as a distinct conflict.

This framing stays strictly inside the StarCraft II-era nomenclature that most of the thread now favors, respects the tight 2504–2505 combat core, and accounts for the documented buffers without forcing an artificial three- or four-year bracket. I therefore continue to support locking the figure at two years.

That core combat window is only twelve to eighteen months of sustained large-scale fighting. The manuals and short stories do reference several months of late-2503 brood-mother consolidation and border skirmishes plus immediate 2505 mop-up and political fallout; when those documented flanking periods receive the same inclusive ceiling convention already applied to the Brood War, the total elapsed span crosses one full calendar year and rounds cleanly to two. Extending the count through 2506–2507 would require folding in the separate Legacy of the Void End War operations on Aiur, which in-universe histories treat as a distinct arc rather than part of the same Second Great War. The narrower 2504–2505 window therefore remains the most consistent match to both the game timelines and the official lore summaries without importing events already assigned to other campaigns.

9.text: PUBLIC RESPONSE: Colleague 1 and the cluster around C5/C9/C13/C14 have the most disciplined reading: the Dominion–Zerg core runs from the late-2504 Wings resurgence through the 2505 Char resolution, a window the manuals place inside roughly twelve to eighteen months of sustained operations once the separate Brood War cleanup and Legacy epilogue are excluded. The documented late-2503 border skirmishes and brood-mother activity add only a few months at the front, while the immediate political reconstruction and mop-up extend a comparable distance into early 2505. Applying the same inclusive calendar convention the group has already used for the Brood War, those flanking partial years push the total elapsed span just over one full calendar year and cleanly ceiling to two. Extending any farther requires folding in the 2506–2507 Aiur and End War phases that the in-universe histories explicitly treat as a distinct campaign. The 2504–2505 span therefore remains the tightest match to both the game timelines and the official lore summaries while still respecting the partial-year buffers the short stories and opening briefings reference.

7.text:
PUBLIC RESPONSE: The 2504–2507 arc under the now-dominant SCII-era definition continues to look the most consistent with how the manuals, Chronicle, and in-universe histories actually bracket the Dominion–Zerg–Protoss campaigns. Late-2504 Wings opening through the 2505 Heart resolution on Char already gives roughly eighteen months of sustained fighting once the documented late-2503 brood-mother lead-ins are folded in, and the immediate post-Char political consolidation stretches well into 2505. Adding the Legacy of the Void End War phase on Aiur and the final Char mop-up (explicitly placed in 2506–2507 by the same sources) pushes the elapsed span to approximately three calendar years of continuous large-scale operations.  

When the same inclusive/ceiling convention the group has applied to the Brood War is used here—counting every partial year that appears in the official timelines—the four distinct label years 2504, 2505, 2506, and 2507 produce the conventional four-year rounded-up figure. The narrower 2504–2505 core reading favored by several colleagues remains attractive for its tight combat focus, yet it systematically excludes the documented flanking periods and the Legacy operations that current Blizzard chronology treats as part of the same Second Great War arc. That narrower window therefore undercounts the total span the lore summaries themselves quote. The ~3 yr elapsed / ~4 yr inclusive result is the figure that aligns most cleanly with the dominant in-universe nomenclature and the rounding practice already established in this thread.

Current Blizzard / Chronicle usage puts the name “Second Great War” on the Dominion / Zerg / Protoss war told in StarCraft II, not on the post-Overmind Brood War.

On the Koprulu calendar that is

* c. late-mid 2504 – Wings of Liberty opening, Kerrigan re-arming / return and the first Dominion-wide Zerg offensives on Korhal / Mar Sara;
* c. 2505-2506 – Heart of the Swarm and the Char / Dominion-Swarm phase;
* c. 2506-2507 – Legacy of the Void End War, Aiur purification and the final Zerg operations on Char.

Strict elapsed is ~≈3 yr of active Second Great War campaigning. With the partial first and last years treated on the inclusive / ceiling calendar convention the manuals and Chronicle use for Great Wars, the span is quoted as the label set 2504, 2505, 2506, 2507.

Ceilinging the ~3+ yr fractional elapsed span to whole years is the commonly cited ~4 yr inclusive figure for the canonically named Second Great War: ~3 yr elapsed, routinely rounded up to 4 yr inclusive.

Under the SCII-era definition that is now carrying the Second Great War name in this round the rounded-up inclusive duration is 4 years, ~3 years elapsed.
